spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (पूजयनि)
To adore, to reverence, to worship.
With सम्,
to pay respect to.

f. (-जा)
Worship, culture, respect, homage of superiors or adoration of the gods.
E.
पूज to worship, aff. अङ् and टाप.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Worshipping, a worshipper.
E.
पूज to worship, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्)
Worshipping, reverencing.
E.
पूज to worship, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Worship, worshipping: see पूजा.
f. (-नी)
A sparrow.
E.
पूज to worship, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be worshipped or revered.
E.
पूज and अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be worshipped.
E.
पूज to worship, and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Worshipping, a worshipper.
E.
पूज to worship, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Worshipful, venerable, respectable, sacred.
E.
पूजा worship, अर्ह fit, deserving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Worshipped, adored, reverenced.
E.
पूज to worship, क्त aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Venerable, respectable, worshipful, &c.
m. (-लः)
A deity.
E.
पूजा, and इलच् aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Worshipful, venerable, fit for or deserving adoration, &c.
m. (-ज्यः)
A father-in-law.
E.
पूज to worship, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being reverenced or respected.
E.
पूज to worship, pass. v., शानच् aff.
